SUCCESSOR REPLAY - HOLD transfers to exact e50c7040c41b82c2db022083182c975e46ac66a8; 245b013 remains withdrawn.

I checked the exact 245..e50 delta before replay. The only production change is acquire/output.scala source-admission sealing; neither AcquisitionViewAuthority/ExtendedBuildReceipt nor the codec source-outcome dispatch changed. Fresh exact archive /private/tmp/storymodel4s-output-e50-review.Yy5gcy reproduces both earlier blockers:

1. Caller-minted ValidatedBuild authority still succeeds. The attack uses a public BuildReceipt claiming a never-run stage, inconsistent empty ExtendedBuildReceipt.stages, and Long.MinValue timestamp. AcquisitionViewAuthority.validatedBuild accepts it, AcquisitionAccount.of accepts it, and AdmittedViewBasis.fromAcquisition publishes BasisAuthority.ValidatedBuild.

2. A valid SourceOutcome.Refused(BeforeIntake, ...) result still encodes, while both StoryOutputResultCodec.decode(text) and decode(text, emptyBytes) return Left. There remains no round-trip route for this admitted domain state.

Fresh temp-only test-file SHA-256: d5f43afa35b3cafccbeade8a72cad59df10bd5b5a687ef2abfd3a282418f70dc view OutputSuite; 5d136833a629ac824d92d9167e7858f2315961a13384db3e3a3fba1766f82c20 codec OutputCodecSuite. Exact command: sbt -batch viewJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.view.OutputSuite codecJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.codec.OutputCodecSuite. Results view 23/23 and codec 10/10, exit 0. Passing means both attack receipts reproduced. This is pre-proposal evidence only: no candidate registration, candidate review, shared source edit, or reservation touch.
